Ruling: model error; i1040gi p. 89, Line 2a: "Alimony received is not included in your income if you entered into a divorce or separation agreement after December 31, 2018". The project asks s1.alimony (alimony under a pre-2019 agreement, counting only payments before a post-2018 change that expressly applies the post-2018 rules, p504 p. 16, as reworded by the income package's PENDING-3) and only then the amount and the s1.alimony_unsupported screen (amb.2025.alimony_screen). The candidate copies s1.alimony_received and declares the screen on every return, so it needs the screen and the amount from filers with no alimony, and would include alimony under a post-2018 agreement. executable-triage-v2 (`reviews/2025/transcription/triage/s1.deepseek.json`, written by triage.py this round; 1,565 fixtures, 500 generated returns seed 20261026, 610 partial records from 40 bases; 2,675 comparisons): 1,073 agree; 1,581 candidate-unknown, 21 project-unknown (on completed returns: 165 candidate-unknown). The reply copies s1.alimony_received with no s1.alimony guard, so it needs the amount on every return. The 21 project-unknown are partials withholding the s1.alimony answer the interview asks first, all on incomplete or refused returns. BUG-0394's new exclusions in the amount (instrument designating payments as not alimony; same-household payments under a decree, with the one-month exception) match p504 pp. 14-15 and change no expression. Same disagreement as the bklg ruling, which stands. Project stands.
